messages:
Carmen: dropped a new mock for Compliance → Data custody & retention. screenshot + link in the doc: https://doc.redwood/custody-retention
Nikhil: nice. quick read — what are the must-fix nits vs nice-to-haves?
Carmen: must-fix: KMS wording, retention control visibility on small screens, and audit log labels. nice-to-have: retention impact estimator and an optional cost delta preview.
Samira: re KMS: support keeps getting tickets where customers think 'Customer key' means Redwood stores keys. propose exact phrasing: 'Key custody: Customer-managed (BYOK) — You hold the key.' For Redwood-managed: 'Key custody: Redwood-managed (HSM-backed)'.
Eli: +1 to explicit "Key custody" prefix. also add a tiny HSM shield icon for HSM-backed keys so users can visually distinguish.
Nikhil: accessibility: we should expose SR text when toggling custody: 'Now using customer-managed key; Redwood does not have key material.' Keep it short.
a11y-bot: a11y scan: lock/shield icon contrast on light theme 2.5:1 (fail). Options: darker fill or add 1px stroke (#0B2A3A) to meet 3:1.
Carmen: retention control visibility: on 320px widths the dropdown falls below the fold. proposal: compact row: [Region ▾]  [Auto-delete after: 30 days ▾]  [Key custody: Customer ▾]
Nikhil: agree. UI note: keep numeric input separate from unit selector so we can offer hours/minutes for short lifespans (dev orgs).
Samira: security nit: if retention <24h and org >1TB, force a confirm modal with stronger copy and require checkbox, not text typing. reduce accidental wipes.
Carmen: microcopy: change label from 'Retention (days)' to 'Auto-delete after' and helper: 'Data will be permanently removed after this period. Exports for legal holds may persist per policy.'
Eli: love the estimator idea: show '~2,400 objects (~92MB) — est. savings $0.12/mo' under the selector. Put it muted and behind a feature flag.
Nikhil: implementation note: estimator will approximate based on object counts and average size; add FF `retention-estimator-v1`.
Samira: privacy note: estimator should not leak per-record details; aggregate only.
Carmen: audit log copy: current table shows raw ids like `kms.key_rotate` and `data.retention_applied`. UX: display friendly title and show raw id in a collapsed JSON view. e.g., table cell: 'Key rotated' and beneath small text in mono: `kms.key_rotate` when expanded.
Nikhil: will map events in a label map with fallback to raw string. also add a filter chip row: [All] [KMS] [Retention] [Exports] with counts.
Samira: also add actor disambiguation: some events are service-initiated (scheduler) vs user-initiated. column 'Actor' should show 'System (scheduler)' or 'User — alice@example.com'.
Carmen: timestamp format ask: show local tz + relative time: 'May 14 2026, 11:12 PDT — 7m ago' with header toggle to force UTC.
Nikhil: keyboard flow needs to be explicit: desired tab order: toggle -> region -> retention input -> unit -> estimator -> key custody -> save. Retention and custody changes should announce via aria-live polite: 'Auto-delete set to 30 days' and 'Using customer-managed key'.
a11y-bot: keyboard checklist: ensure the estimator is reachable and has role="status" for announcements; ensure audit table rows are focusable with aria-expanded on details.
Samira: confirm modals: change from 'Are you sure?' to 'Permanently delete data after [X]? This cannot be undone.' add secondary line: 'Consider exporting data first. Legal holds may retain copies.' and include a small inline link to policy.
Eli: UI experiment: for long retention->short retention changes, show an inline banner instead of modal: 'Shortening retention will schedule an immediate purge in 24h. [View details]'. Use modal only for hyper-destructive thresholds.
Carmen: styling nits: KMS badge contrast and icon stroke, small gap above helper text on compact rows, and focus ring color on seeds looks off in dark theme.
Nikhil: noted. i'll update CSS tokens and add 1px stroke fallback for icons. will include dark theme checks.
deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled 2026-05-20 05:00 UTC. add feature flags: `retention-estimator-v1`, `custody-clarity-v1`.
Carmen: thanks everyone. i'll update the mock with copy changes and push PR. tagging @Nikhil @Samira @Eli for reviews. :thumbsup:
